title: Complex presentation of a prescribed varying-coefficient raw cocone
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ have affine transitions and qcqs structure maps. Let $c$ have limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure map. Write $g_i:X_i\to S$, $g:X\to S$, $a_f:X_j\to X_i$ and $a_i:X\to X_i$ for the structure, transition and cone maps. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with maps $\varphi_f:a_f^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], satisfying the canonical unital and composition HEq equations displayed in the Lean signature. Let $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathbf{Ab})$ have a colimit, with $eH_i:H_i\simeq a_i^{-1}F_i$ and $H(f)=eH_i;\mathrm{upperStarComp};a_j^{-1}(\varphi_f);eH_j^{-1}$. Fix $p\in\mathbf N$ and affine etale $U\to S$. Let $K:I\to\mathbf{Ab}$, $B$ a cocone on $K$, $e_i:\mathrm{raw}(g_i,p,F_i)(U)\simeq K_i$, and $e_B:\mathrm{raw}(g,p,\operatorname{colim}H)(U)\simeq B_{\mathrm{pt}}$ be additive isomorphisms [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison]. Require $K(f)(e_i(t))=e_j(\mathrm{rawPullback}_{a_f,\varphi_f}(t))$ and $B_i(e_i(t))=e_B(\mathrm{rawPullback}_{a_i,eH_i^{-1};\iota_i}(t))$ for every raw class $t$. Then the reindexed diagram $\mathrm{unopUnop}(I);K$ and cocone $B$ whiskered by this equivalence admit an abelian complex cohomology presentation [def-sbc-etale-complex-cohomology-presentation]: qcqs limiting scheme system with affine transitions, coherent single complexes bounded below by zero, a colimiting coefficient cocone, the canonical derived-adjunction-unit maps, and stage and limit cohomology isomorphisms intertwining both transitions and legs. No colimit assertion on $B$, injectivity, surjectivity or eventual vanishing is asserted.

proof.text: Base change the scheme diagram and limiting cone along affine U. Pullback universal properties give the maps, functor laws and limiting property. Affine transition permanence and qcqs base change give qcqs stages. Restrict coefficients, transport their identities and composition through upperStarComp, and place them in single complexes. Restrict H at the limit, using eH and hH for the pulled-back diagram. Restriction is a left adjoint and preserves the coefficient colimit; single complexes preserve it termwise, giving the coefficient cocone L. All complexes vanish below zero.

Use the natural additive raw/restricted-cohomology comparison at every stage and at the limit. It is computed by the free-sheaf sections adjunction on an injective resolution; etale restriction preserves injectives and D+ includes fully faithfully in D. Compose these isomorphisms with e_i inverse and e_B inverse to identify K and B.pt with the cohomology of the constructed complexes.

Set P to the exact derived adjunction-unit and global-sections comparison map in the presentation. Naturality of the raw/restricted comparison for each stage arrow identifies the five-factor raw map with P followed by cohomology of its coefficient map. The hmap equation then supplies the presentation transition equation, by homomorphism extensionality. Applying the same calculation to each cone projection and hleg supplies the leg equation. Reindex through the double-opposite equivalence. This constructs the presentation without applying continuity.
